changes_summary.description: Allowed URL_QUERY schema variants (both 'type' and 'mechanism_type' starting with 'URL_QUERY'), resolved param from 'param', 'query_param' or parsed parameter name from mechanism transition metadata, dynamically applying runtime brand without hardcoding.

Checked mechanism_type compatibility starting with 'URL_QUERY', ensured _furl is tracked in category scope, and enforced _target fallback to _furl if built so unconstrained raw category URLs are never requested for brand audits.
